Directions: Mix one serving (1 scoop) into water, pre-workout, or drink of your choice.
Initial creatine loading phase: Consume one serving up to four times throughout the day with water and a meal for 5-7 days.
Ongoing creatine maintenance: Consume one serving once per day.
Storage: store in a cool, dry place.
Caution: Do not exceed recommended dose. Consume with water during supplementation. Excessive creatine intake can result in stomach discomfort, diarrhea, or cramping.
Children under the age of 18 and individuals who are pregnant, nursing or with medical conditions should consult a physician before taking supplements.
